about.title: Our story
about.intro: A lifelong wine enthusiast, I took over a ten-hectare wine estate in Anjou toward the end of my career, after working in a different field. Guided by quality, I am learning this demanding craft with humility, as part of a shared adventure with people and nature.
about.story_title: A change of life inspired by a passion
about.story: After a career in a completely different field, I decided to pursue a project I had long dreamed of: becoming a winegrower. Driven by a lasting passion for wine, I wanted to understand and experience the whole winemaking process, from vine to bottle. Giving myself to it fully, physically and emotionally, felt like a natural choice.

michel.bio: Come wind, rain or snow, Michel is always out working in the vines. Between showers, you may find him walking his dog Rika through the vineyard.

christophe.bio: With over 35 years at a renowned Loire estate, Christophe always has something to share. You may find him inside a vat or among the rows of vines.

tanguy.bio: Studying business at the École supérieure des agricultures in Angers as part of a work-study program, Tanguy can introduce you to the different wines. You may find him at the estate between university sessions.
